qa_pair.question: Using the Jira MCP tools, list every available workflow transition for issue PROJ-1 and return the comma-separated transition names in alphabetical order.
Use jira_search_issues with the JQL "project = PROJ AND status = Done ORDER BY created ASC". Limit results to 1. What is the issue key of the oldest Done issue in PROJ?
Call jira_get_my_issues with no project filter and limit=1. What is the status name of the highest-priority issue currently assigned to the authenticated user?

Call jira_summarize_issue for PROJ-2 with include_comments=true and comment_limit=1. How many comments does the issue currently have, as reported in the returned "count" field of the comments section?
Use jira_list_agile_boards filtered by project_key=PROJ. What is the integer id of the board named "PROJ board"?
Use jira_list_board_sprints for board id 10 with state="active". What is the name of the currently active sprint?
Call jira_list_sprint_issues for sprint id 50. How many issues are in the sprint, as reported in the "total" field of the paginated response?
Call confluence_get_page with page_id=100000. What is the title of the page?
Use confluence_search with cql='space = DOC AND type = page AND title = "Release Notes"' and limit=1. What is the page id of the matching page?
Call confluence_get_page_labels for page_id=100100. Return the comma-separated label names sorted alphabetically.
